interaction_models: interactive local branch selector (`git town switch`)

native_allocation.linux: Required; supported by pinned release targets and upstream Ubuntu workflows.
native_allocation.macos: Upstream release target supports Darwin, but not selected for this project's planned cell.
native_allocation.windows: Planned second cell; pinned upstream Windows workflow and release target support it.

open_before_execution: Complete at least 20 frozen, useful, risk-diverse scenarios with eight normal and twelve edge cases.
Identify and exercise three distinct safe real target faults after scenario freeze; preserve baseline, corrupted execution and restored recovery.
Run the declared Linux and Windows native matrices through standard GitHub-hosted workflows and retrieve/audit artifacts.
Complete public recorder/no-handwritten-spec authoring, selective maintenance, relocation and workflow delivery assessment.
Requalify any changed prior-project cases on the actual final candidate; all current and final-candidate gates remain open.
Perform bounded target/report/process cleanup and retain exact pinned source/provenance.

safe_execution_policy.credentials: Unset forge tokens and isolate Git/GitHub CLI configuration under campaign-owned empty homes.
safe_execution_policy.network: No network-dependent Git Town command; build from vendored dependencies with module network disabled.
safe_execution_policy.processes: Bound Git Town, Git, helper, output, deadlines, process-tree cleanup and workspace disposal independently.
safe_execution_policy.remotes: None; do not add a live remote.
safe_execution_policy.repository: Fresh synthetic local Git repository under an owned campaign workspace.
safe_execution_policy.target_trust: Explicitly trusted MIT source, built from the exact pin.

archive_preflight.correction: The prior review reversed the relationship. At the pinned Git tree both paths are regular files; CLAUDE.md contains the literal text @AGENTS.md. The GitHub tarball contains both as regular files.
archive_preflight.reviewed_link_policy: No archive links are present; extraction must reject any unexpected link type.

source_review.build_hooks: No custom build hook is required for direct Go compilation. The upstream Makefile bootstraps developer tools through run-that-app; do not invoke its install or release targets. Go source modules are vendored; use the vendored tree and disable network module resolution.
source_review.omitted_source_links_correction: At the pinned tree both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are regular files. The prior review reversed their relationship; the GitHub source tarball contains no symlinks or hardlinks. The extractor refuses unexpected links under the empty-link policy.
source_review.upstream_linux_ci: Pinned end-to-end and unit workflows run on Ubuntu.
source_review.upstream_windows_ci: Pinned Windows workflow uses actions/setup-go with go.mod and runs the Windows smoke suite.

state_oracle_candidate.meaningful_state: Local Git configuration and branch/ref state in the case-owned repository.
state_oracle_candidate.public_contract_candidate: Spec v3 rooted state checks of selected files such as .git/HEAD and .git/config, plus exact terminal/exit assertions. Confirm path validation and same-execution behavior before freezing scenarios.
state_oracle_candidate.qualification: Initial native Windows public spec v3 cases proved workspace fixture copying and same-run terminal, exit, .git/HEAD and exact state outcomes: N01 hack, N02 append, N03 config parent read, N04 branch hierarchy and N05 prototype creation. Development-only; no final series, fault, calibration or admission credit.
